en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small rural European village in a hilly landscape. In the foreground there is a pond surrounded by trees and dense vegetation. Beyond it lie open fields and scattered farmhouses and village houses with steep gabled roofs, arranged along gentle slopes. Forested hills rise in the distance under a cloudy sky. The print number "6523B" appears in the lower right corner of the image; the card has a white border with deckled edges, typical of mid‑20th‑century postcards.
